24.original: Place the trilobite meat into the cookpot.

26.original: Take the stew from the cookfire.

27.original: Offer the stew to the Ondo culinarian.

28.original: Deliver the stew to Pulshs Ooan.

48.original: Finless one, is it true that on the shhhore, your people treat your food with fire to make it last longer?

49.original: Ah hah, I thought so! You see, ever since the waters withdrew, our foodstuffs have become more prone to rot and decay. Something about exposssure to air, I sssuspect...

50.original: With this in mind, we thought we might try to mimic your fire-assisted methods. We prepared a “cookpot” which was cast into the sea, but despite our best efforts to replicate your techniques, the result was quite disssappointing.

51.original: As a finless one, surely you are more capable of making this so-called ssstew? If you might take this trilobite meat and place it into the cookpot as we obssserve, it would be most educational.

52.original: The others are gathered atop the rise to the eassst. You will forgive me for keeping my distance─I have yet to grow accussstomed to the heat of the flames...

53.original: Please take that trilobite meat to the others tending the pot and demonssstrate for them how a finless one prepares meat over fire. I will...obssserve from afar.

54.original: Ah, finless one! You are come to show us how ssstew is made?

55.original: You deposit the meat into the bubbling broth. All that remains is to wait...

56.original: The makeshift stew appears to have been cooked long enough. Whether or not it will meet with the Ondo's approval, however, remains to be seen...

57.original: Is the ssstew ready yet, finless one...?

58.original: Ahh! So hot it is, like the boiling currentsss near the deepwater vents!

59.original: But it must be this hot, else the meat will ssspoil, yes? I see...so fearful of the heat were we that we did not consssider cooking it longer. But now we know.

60.original: Thank you for teaching us, finless one. Take with you a portion of the ssstew back to Pulshs Ooan that he may sssavor this taste for himself.

61.original: Pulshs Ooan must know the taste of this ssstew. Take to him that portion.

62.original: Well? Were you able to educate the others, finless one?

63.original: How hot it is, yet delicious! To think such wonders could be born of deadly fire. Thank you for teaching us the proper methods.
